item.title: Authorization Connectors
item.description: Authorization Connectors is one page listing every identity provider DefectDojo Pro supports, what state each one is in, and what protocol it speaks. Before it existed, each provider lived on its own settings form and there was no way to answer “what is set up on this instance?” without opening all of them.

item.title: Login Settings
item.description: Once you have an SSO provider working, Login Settings controls how the DefectDojo login page itself behaves — whether username/password login is still offered, whether visitors are sent straight to your identity provider, how long a session lasts, and whether SSO can create accounts on the fly. Open-source DefectDojo does not include these controls — see Authorized Users.

item.title: SAML Configuration
item.description: DefectDojo Pro supports SAML authentication via the Enterprise Settings UI. Open-source DefectDojo does not include SSO — see Authorized Users for open-source access control.

item.title: OIDC
item.description: DefectDojo Pro supports login via a generic OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider. Open-source DefectDojo does not include SSO — see Authorized Users for open-source access control.

item.title: Auth0
item.description: DefectDojo Pro supports login via Auth0 over OAuth 2.0. Open-source DefectDojo does not include SSO — see Authorized Users for open-source access control.

item.title: Azure Active Directory
item.description: DefectDojo Pro supports login via Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory) over OAuth 2.0, including automatic User Group synchronization. Open-source DefectDojo does not include SSO — see Authorized Users for open-source access control.

item.title: GitHub Enterprise
item.description: DefectDojo Pro supports login via GitHub Enterprise Server over OAuth 2.0. Open-source DefectDojo does not include SSO — see Authorized Users for open-source access control.

item.title: GitLab
item.description: DefectDojo Pro supports login via GitLab (SaaS or self-hosted) over OAuth 2.0. Open-source DefectDojo does not include SSO — see Authorized Users for open-source access control.

item.title: Google Auth
item.description: DefectDojo Pro supports login via Google accounts over OAuth 2.0. New users are created automatically on first login if they don’t already exist, and existing DefectDojo users are matched to Google accounts by username (the portion before the @ in their Google email). Open-source DefectDojo does not include SSO — see Authorized Users for open-source access control.

item.title: KeyCloak
item.description: DefectDojo Pro supports login via KeyCloak over OAuth 2.0. Open-source DefectDojo does not include SSO — see Authorized Users for open-source access control.
